anchor: quarter turn 90°, half turn 180°, full turn 360°

lessons.focus: Measure and classify angles with a protractor. Critical feature: read the scale that starts at 0 on your arm. Review: FDP (Term 3 Weeks 5 and 9).
Estimate, draw and measure reflex angles. Critical feature: estimate against 90° and 180° first; reflex = 360° minus the inside. Review: FDP (Term 3 Weeks 8 and 9).
Angles on a straight line, at a point, and in a right angle. Critical feature: find the whole (90°, 180°, 360°) first. Review: FDP (Term 3 Weeks 6 and 9).
Vertically opposite angles and mixed unknowns. Critical feature: name the angle fact with every answer. Review: four processes (Term 3 Week 7).
